name: Pony
abilities: A small, hardy horse valued for its endurance, sure footing, and modest upkeep, commonly used by travelers, children, and those of limited means.

name: Mule
abilities: A sturdy cross between a horse and a donkey, prized for its strength, endurance, and sure footing when carrying heavy loads across difficult terrain.

name: Draft Horse
abilities: A large, powerful horse bred for pulling plows, carts, and heavily laden wagons, valued for its strength and steady temperament rather than speed.

name: Riding Horse
abilities: A dependable saddle horse bred for comfortable travel, commonly ridden by merchants, messengers, household retainers, and travelers throughout the Seven Kingdoms.

name: Courser
abilities: A swift, agile horse bred for speed and maneuverability, favored by knights, scouts, and mounted warriors who rely on rapid movement in battle.|Battle-Trained: May willingly enter Engaged range with hostile characters and may be directed to make attacks.|Swift: Add 1 Boost die to Riding checks involving speed, pursuit, escape, or maneuvering at a gallop.

name: Destrier
abilities: A powerful and exceptionally valuable warhorse bred and trained for the shock of mounted combat, capable of bearing an armored knight into the fiercest fighting.|Warhorse: Ignores Setback dice imposed by ordinary combat distractions. May willingly enter Engaged range with hostile characters and may be directed to make attacks.|Powerful Charge: When the destrier performs a Charge, its Hooves attack gains +1 damage.
